title: feat(plugin-grid): `rowActions` narrows inside the `operations` ceiling (#10083)
body:
Fixes #10083
Clause-②: no

## What

The narrowing half of ruling batch #162 item 1, letter A (ruling-ref comment `5729875720` on objectui#9819, maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-18T12:18Z). The ceiling half already shipped in PR objectui#10081.

`resolveRowCrudAffordances` now implements the ruled formula for both gates:

`canEdit = operationsUpdate AND (wantEditAction OR DEFAULT-WHEN-ROWACTIONS-ABSENT) AND hasOnEdit AND objectCanEdit`, and the delete gate the same way.

- `ObjectGrid` passes a new `rowActionsDeclared` flag (`Array.isArray(schema.rowActions)`), read before the existing `[]` fallback erases it. Absent `rowActions` still arrives as a `false` from `includes()`, so this flag is what tells "absent" apart from "declared without this name".
- An absent list takes the default arm (today's behaviour). A declared list, including an empty one or one that names only custom actions, offers the generic entry only for the canonical `'edit'` / `'delete'` it carries.
- `objectCanDelete` (the bulk-delete verdict) is untouched. Bulk delete runs on `onBulkDelete`, not on the row selection.

Landing: `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (the `rowActions` read and the call only) and `packages/plugin-grid/src/rowCrudAffordances.ts`. That is the producer PM expected, and no other producer was needed. `resolveRowCrudAffordances` has exactly one runtime caller (`ObjectGrid`). The other files that mention the name do so only in comments.

## Pins (the three directions the ruling names, plus the absent-rowActions control)

In `__tests__/gridOperationsMembers-8071.test.tsx`, each claim is read out of an opened row kebab:
- **ceiling refuses**: `update: false` survives `rowActions: [edit]` (unchanged). The unnamed-member ceiling case now declares `rowActions: ['edit', 'delete']`, so that only the ceiling can withhold Edit.
- **rowActions narrows**: the former `⚠️ NOT IMPLEMENTED` case is **flipped, not deleted**. `operations: {update, delete}` plus `rowActions: ['edit']` now yields Edit only. A companion case shows the narrowing also applies under the wired-callback default when `operations` is absent (`rowActions: ['delete']` yields Delete only).
- **absent operations keeps defaults**: `rowActions: ['edit', 'delete']` with no `operations` block keeps both.
- **absent rowActions keeps defaults** (new control): `operations: {update, delete}` with no `rowActions` keeps both.
- A declared empty list offers no generic entry, and the row grows no kebab.

`__tests__/rowCrudAffordances.test.ts` gains a `#10083` block with the same facts at the gate, plus one case showing that the bulk verdict is unaffected.

## Behaviour change (changeset `@object-ui/plugin-grid` **minor**)

`.changeset/10083-rowactions-narrow.md` carries the ruling's note: a page that wrote `operations.OP: false` together with a `rowActions` entry for it now hides that button. It also carries the narrowing note: a view that declares `rowActions` without `'edit'` / `'delete'` loses the generic entry, and the remedy is to name it.

**Measured population (assumption 5): which authored `rowActions` arrays change output.**
- objectui, authored/example surfaces: `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/plugin-grid/object-grid-selection-summaries.json` declares `["view", "edit"]` and now loses generic Delete. The docs/README samples (`content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`, `content/docs/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx`, `packages/plugin-grid/README.md`) all name both `edit` and `delete`, so they do not change. The `data-table` `rowActions: true` fixtures are a different component (a boolean), so they do not change either.
- objectstack (sibling; the metadata the console actually renders): one view, `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/views/task.view.ts` `legacy_row_actions`, declares custom names only (`['showcase_recalc_estimate', 'showcase_quick_view']`). Under the ruled formula it now loses both generic Edit and Delete. `packages/lint/src/showcase-shape.fixtures.ts` mirrors it. No other objectstack example declares `rowActions`.
- The spec declares `ListViewSchema.rowActions` as `z.array(z.string()).optional()` with no default. The producers (`app-shell` `ObjectView`, `plugin-view` `ObjectView`, `plugin-list` `ListView`) forward `undefined` when nothing was authored, never `[]`. So an unauthored view does not trip the narrowing.

## Tests (final HEAD `92214a4`, base `62597c5`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-grid/` (via os-verify-lock): `Test Files 146 passed (146)`, `Tests 1394 passed (1394)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` (runs `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; `--listFiles` shows both edited test files are in the test project): exit 0. It first needed the dependency closure built (`pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-grid^...' run build`, exit 0).
- `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: `199 passed`, not edited. The ruled change did not force an edit.
- Adjacent consumers: `plugin-view` `objectViewHostSurface.test.tsx` and the two `plugin-designer` system-delete suites passed, 20/20.
- eslint (`--no-inline-config`) on the 4 changed source/test files: 0 errors. The warnings are all pre-existing lines; none are on lines this PR adds.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0 (1 changeset declared). `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.

**Reverse verification** (run after the commit, via `ablation-replace.mjs`, with the restore proved by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`):
1. `selectsDelete = true` (narrowing removed): 5 tests went red, including the flipped integration pin and the empty-list case.
2. `selectsDelete = !!opts.wantDeleteAction` (narrowing on the bare `includes()` answer, ignoring declaration): 19 went red, including the new `ABSENT rowActions keeps the default` control and the file's pre-existing `CONTROL` case. This proves that the control can fail for the reason it exists.

## Acceptance notes

- The describe-text clause of the ruling ("`operations` is the ceiling") is carried by objectui#10084 in `packages/types`. It is not in this PR.
- The earlier changeset `.changeset/issue-9819-operations-ceiling.md` (from the ceiling half, not yet released) still says the narrowing "is NOT part of this change". That is true of that change, and this PR's changeset states the second half. The earlier file was left untouched because it is outside this claim's file surface.
- The showcase `legacy_row_actions` view (objectstack) loses its generic Edit/Delete by ruling. If that fixture is meant to keep them, the objectstack-side fix is to add `'edit', 'delete'` to its list. That is not done here.
